short: Atta — the engine for the Den: resolve, route, render
is: Atta, the host-agnostic engine for the Den: it resolves the tree, enforces its structural rules, asks the host about each node through one object-safe trait Atta defines, and renders files. Types and content are opaque to it; the host answers per type with an exhaustive match in application, never a runtime registry. It lives in this workspace as a crate only until it is split into its own library.
conventions: Never depends on another workspace crate and never names a Zurfur type — host-agnostic by construction, so it can be split out unchanged.

One exception: two tests read shared case files from outside the crate — src/ordinal/tests.rs reads contract/golden/name-ordinals.json and src/segment/tests.rs reads contract/golden/segments.json; when Atta is split out, those tests move with the files.
Used by application only; the API never imports it.
Its role is fixed: resolve, enforce structure, route changes, render. How it does that grows only as real needs appear, never ahead of them.
Nothing reads a node except through Atta; a payload is served only after its hash verifies, and until that check exists no payload is served at all.
Fails closed: one uniform not-found, no stored level means Private, and a mount whose target is not directly under a top-level directory is refused.

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: crate manifest — external crates only, never a workspace crate; tracing (the resolver's and the writer's debug spans and outcome events) and strum (the outcome names); tracing-subscriber for the log tests, trybuild for the compile-fail test

fs.name: src/act.rs
fs.role: the named act in Atta's own vocabulary: ActName (an opaque word, like Type), Placed (a node an act touches, as the den found it), Born (a node an act makes; its key born as written, never decoded), Shape (Create, Rename, Change) and Act<B> (word, type, shape, an opaque body); hand-written Debugs print no path, segment or name

fs.name: src/fake.rs
fs.role: test-only Host over an in-memory tree that records every call, and every act it applies

fs.name: src/host.rs
fs.role: the one Host trait (child, children, mounts, kind, admit; no payload method; associated Act and Applied types and a provided apply that refuses unless the host overrides it) and the values it speaks: Viewer, Lift, Found, Mount, Access, Reach, Admission

fs.name: src/level.rs
fs.role: Level: Private < Listed < Public

fs.name: src/lib.rs
fs.role: façade: the crate doc, #![forbid(unsafe_code)] and the public surface

fs.name: src/list.rs
fs.role: Resolver::list: one page of an open directory; Private and refused entries drop before the sort, the numbering and the cut; ordered by name_order, then segment, cards by a keyed hash; each entry numbered among its equal names over the whole filtered listing. Resolver::tell_apart: after a walk succeeds, numbers its node and crumbs from the listing of each folder on the Den path, each listed once

fs.name: src/metadata.rs
fs.role: Metadata, the closed per-node field set; Type, the opaque type key; DisplayName, a node's display name as the host checked it (Atta holds no name rule), with one constructor, the inherent DisplayName::host_checked, so the host can ban every other call by path

fs.name: src/ordering.rs
fs.role: name_order: digit runs by value, every other character on its own and case-insensitively (a final sigma as σ), then the name itself (a file manager's order); proptests.rs checks it is a total order

fs.name: src/ordinal.rs
fs.role: NameOrdinal, 2 or more (TryFrom<u32>, Into<u32>), and the numbering rule: entries grouped by comparison_key (the exact name for now; NFC later changes only that function), each group in tiebreak order, the first plain, each later the smallest rising n whose "name (n)" key no visible entry holds and none was given; ordinal/tests.rs also checks every case in contract/golden/name-ordinals.json, the file the web's copy of the rule answers to

fs.name: src/page.rs
fs.role: PageToken (a version and an offset, hex; FromStr and Display) and Listing

fs.name: src/path.rs
fs.role: RealPath, a node real path from the global root

fs.name: src/resolve.rs
fs.role: Resolver::resolve_path: a typed Den path from the viewer root, the level formula, standing along the real path, mounts and the mount guard, admit at each step, one NotFound; it records each step (the folder left, the segment taken) and never lists a folder, so its entries carry no number; Entry (with its NameOrdinal), Resolved, Caps (the read caps: max_den_path, 16 segments of a Den path from the viewer's root, and page_size); Resolver<'h, A = (), P = ()> names its host as &dyn Host<Act = A, Applied = P>

fs.name: src/segment.rs
fs.role: Segment, a node key: the ASCII allowlist, 1 to 2048 bytes, never . or ..; segment/tests.rs also checks every case in contract/golden/segments.json, the file kernel's NodeSegment and the store's node_segment_shape check answer to

fs.name: src/write.rs
fs.role: WriteCaps (max_real_depth, 8 real segments below / by default; apart from the read caps); Writer::act: the five generic checks, run by reference so Writer::dry_run shares them (it answers the refusal act would meet, or (), applies nothing, takes the host by shared reference, and makes no Checked) (a file holds no entries; born Private unless the creator picks wider; never wider than its parent, entries against their node; the depth cap, WriteCaps::max_real_depth; no generic write: only a node of the act's own type, entries' keys distinct), then Host::apply; a refusal (the typed Refusal) reaches no host; Checked<B>, private fields, made only here, proves the checks ran and carries each born node's settled level, never authority; WriteError; logs outcome class, act word and depth at debug; Debugs print no viewer, path, segment or name; write/tests.rs names a test per check, and the dry run answering each act as act does while the host sees no call and no apply

fs.name: tests/no_workspace_dependency.rs
fs.role: guard: atta depends on no workspace crate, of any kind (cargo metadata)

fs.name: tests/resolve_log.rs
fs.role: alone in its binary (callsite interest): over its own host, each resolve and list logs its outcome class (open, card, not_found, host_error) and depth at debug, never a path, segment, viewer or host error

fs.name: tests/ui.rs
fs.role: trybuild harness: each tests/ui/*.rs must fail to compile, with the message in its .stderr

fs.name: tests/ui/
fs.role: compile-fail cases: checked_by_literal.rs, a Checked built by struct literal outside Atta

fs.name: tests/write_log.rs
fs.role: alone in its binary (callsite interest): over its own host, each act logs its outcome class (applied, refused with its refusal class, host_error), its word and its depth at debug, never a viewer, path, segment, name or host error

notes: Name: Atta is the leafcutter-ant genus.
Runs on the server for the MVP; the same crate is built for the browser later.
Not yet in Atta, waiting for the first payload: the payload hash in Metadata, Payload, and attributes. Links resolve nowhere yet: a symlink handed to Atta fails closed as absent.

Equal names in one folder are told apart at read time, never stored: the number is computed per viewer over the filtered listing (hidden entries never count, and the sort still uses the bare name), and a node read numbers its node and crumbs through Resolver::tell_apart only after the plain walk succeeded, so an access check that only walks lists nothing.
